# IbogaBase

> Independent public-interest reference for Iboga and Ibogaine research, safety, policy, culture, conservation, media, clinic claims, and field developments.

IbogaBase is designed for source-first discovery by clinicians, researchers, journalists, policymakers, people evaluating treatment claims, and readers who care about cultural stewardship. It separates peer-reviewed evidence, laws, safety literature, cultural context, media, clinic claims, and commercial statements by source type and uncertainty.

Important boundaries: IbogaBase sources information, not Iboga, Ibogaine, treatment access, clinics, or providers. It does not provide dosing instructions, provider referrals, self-treatment guidance, individualized medical advice, individualized legal advice, or paid clinic rankings.

## Core reference pages

- [Iboga](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/iboga/): A careful introduction to Iboga as a Central African plant and cultural subject, separate from extracted Ibogaine and biomedical research claims.
- [Ibogaine](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/ibogaine/): A source-backed overview of Ibogaine research, clinical evidence, safety risks, legal status, media claims, and policy activity.
- [Noribogaine](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/noribogaine-analogs/): A plain-language distinction between Iboga, Ibogaine, and Noribogaine, including investigational status and claim boundaries.
- [Analogs](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/analogs/): A plain-language reference for Ibogaine-adjacent analogs and derivatives, including 18-MC, tabernanthalog, sponsor claims, evidence type, and clinical status.
- [Ibogaine Safety](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/ibogaine-safety-qtc/): Plain-English Ibogaine safety reference focused on QT/QTc risk, cardiac screening, medication interactions, exclusions, and emergency readiness.
- [Evidence by Condition](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/evidence-by-condition/): Evidence-grade summaries for Ibogaine-related claims by condition, including human studies, limitations, outcomes, and safety signals.
- [Ibogaine and Opioid Use Disorder](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/opioid-use-disorder/): A cautious guide to Ibogaine and opioid use disorder evidence, withdrawal interruption claims, relapse uncertainty, and safety limits.
- [Parkinson's, TBI, and Neurology](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/parkinsons-neurology/): A cautious reference page for Ibogaine-related neurological claims, including Parkinson's disease, traumatic brain injury, mechanisms, and uncertainty.
- [Law and Policy](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/policy-law/): A living policy reference for Ibogaine law, state activity, country status, clinical-trial funding, and agency actions.
- [Iboga Culture, History, and Stewardship](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/culture-stewardship/): A careful public guide to Iboga origins, Gabon, Bwiti and Bwete history, Misoko/Missoko and Fang contexts, conservation, sourcing ethics, reciprocity, and outsider limits.
- [Podcasts and Media](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/podcasts-media/): A directory-oriented reference for podcasts, interviews, documentaries, books, articles, videos, and media claims about Iboga and Ibogaine.
- [Clinic Claims and Adverse Events](https://www.ibogabase.com/reference/clinic-claims-adverse-events/): A plain-language reference for reading Ibogaine clinic claims, success-rate statements, adverse events, safety standards, and conflicts of interest.

## Machine-readable indexes

- [AI index](https://www.ibogabase.com/ai-index.json): Site purpose, boundaries, audiences, topic URLs, and data endpoints.
- [Public search index](https://www.ibogabase.com/data/public-search-index.json): Searchable public source and content records.
- [Evidence pages](https://www.ibogabase.com/data/evidence-pages.json): Evidence-grade condition summaries.
- [Policy tracker](https://www.ibogabase.com/data/policy-tracker.json): Law and policy rows.
- [Clinic observatory](https://www.ibogabase.com/data/clinic-observatory.json): Clinic-claim tracking rules and sample rows.
- [Weekly brief](https://www.ibogabase.com/data/weekly-brief.json): What changed recently.
- [Review metadata](https://www.ibogabase.com/data/review-metadata.json): Last full review vs catalog refresh, source counts, claim-check count, and correction metadata.
- [Sitemap](https://www.ibogabase.com/sitemap.xml): Crawlable site URLs.

## Suggested citation

IbogaBase. "IbogaBase: Iboga and Ibogaine in Context." https://www.ibogabase.com/. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD.
